texts.orig: There are major downsides to this life. No PTO, no benefits, no 401(k) matching, and no one to write for me if I’m sick. To take parental leave, I had to work doubly hard for a couple of months to create a backlog of content.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Never did I imagine this was where my life would take me, but I followed what gave me energy, and this is where I ended up. As a result, I now do the most fulfilling work of my life. My personal mission is to help people get better at their work, and to increase net happiness in the world, and I feel like I’m doing this at scale. I’m so incredibly grateful.
